name: State Duma
notes: 450 seats, 9th convocation (elected 18-20 September 2026): 225 by party list and 225 in single-member districts. Who sits and their faction are from the Duma's own pages (duma.gov.ru), one for each faction and one for the deputies in none. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Federation Council
notes: 177 senators named on the Council's own list (council.gov.ru): two for each region, one from the regional legislature and one from its executive, and up to thirty appointed by the President. Members have no party. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
